foundationPalettes.name: Gremlin Core
foundationPalettes.character: Audacious brand energy with electric greens, disruptive orange, hot pink, purple, blue, mint, yellow, and explicit alert roles.

foundationPalettes.name: Vibe Lavender
foundationPalettes.character: Spa-like lavender, sage, clay, dusty rose, aqua, and chamomile.

foundationPalettes.name: Vibe Marshmallow
foundationPalettes.character: Breakfast-cereal pastels with blueberry, mint, strawberry, grape, peach, and banana milk.

foundationPalettes.name: Vibe Creamsicle
foundationPalettes.character: Warm orange sorbet with denim, pistachio, watermelon, lavender ice, coral, and mint chip.

foundationPalettes.name: Vibe Moonlight
foundationPalettes.character: Dark cosmic color with aurora green, nebula pink, deep-space purple, cyan, coral, and starlight yellow.
